name: send21
description: Crypto pay links and API for people and AI agents. Tools for creating drafts, payment requests, transaction templates, rates, and fees. Agents onboard themselves; humans approve where the money lands. send21 never holds keys or funds.

authentication.description: API key or OAuth sign-in. API key: Authorization: Bearer s21_<api key>, scoped keys at https://send21.io/api-keys. OAuth sign-in: https://send21.io/mcp/oauth (no headers; sign in and approve in the browser). tools/list works unauthenticated.
